presets.name: Original Omarchy
presets.note: Stock Omarchy: the shell follows the fontconfig monospace alias (JetBrainsMono Nerd Font); GTK keeps Adwaita Sans.

licensing.Avenir Next: Commercial (Linotype/Monotype). The copy bundled with macOS is licensed for use on macOS only and must not be copied into this Linux VM. Buy a desktop licence from Monotype, then: omarchy-typography import <files>.
licensing.SF Mono: Apple proprietary. Apple's licence restricts SF Mono to Apple platforms; no Linux desktop licence is offered. Use `omarchy-typography substitute` with an explicitly chosen alternative.
licensing.Neue Montreal Mono: Commercial (Pangram Pangram). A free personal-use trial is available after signing in at pangrampangram.com; download it yourself, then: omarchy-typography import <files>.
licensing.Futura Now Text: Commercial (Monotype). Buy a desktop licence for Futura Now Text, then: omarchy-typography import <files>.
licensing.FF DIN Mono: Commercial (Monotype/FontFont). Buy a desktop licence, then: omarchy-typography import <files>.

notes.Urbanist: No tabular figures in the font (no tnum feature, proportional digits). Clock and readout digits will shift width as they change.
notes.Poppins: No tabular figures in the font (no tnum feature, proportional digits). Clock and readout digits will shift width as they change.
